summary: Frontend-only verification of the chat-bubble vs bid/contract-bubble stacking fix in PlayerSeat.tsx. Logged in as tester1@belote.tn, navigated to /game/local_short_chatbubbletest, announced S/160 to become contract holder (seat 0, bubbleSide='right'), opened chat and sent 'Yezzi!' chip. Measured bounding boxes of both bubbles simultaneously and captured screenshot. Result: chat bubble (y=626, h=23, bottom=649) is placed 9px ABOVE the contract bubble (y=658, h=54), no overlap. Chat auto-hides after ~4s and contract remains visible. Bid/contract bubble alone before chat is unchanged. Fix is verified.

verification_details.screenshot_evidence: /tmp/both_bubbles.png (Yezzi! bubble visibly stacked above gold 160 spades contract bubble next to Tester1)

critical_code_review_comments: PlayerSeat.tsx logic is clean and minimally invasive: only the chat bubble receives the vertical offset+higher zIndex when hasBid is true; bid/contract bubble positioning is untouched. Applies to both bubbleSide variants ('right' shifts top up by 28px + zIndex 13, 'top' shifts top up to -60). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/game/PlayerSeat.tsx:126-144.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing tester1@belote.tn account and local offline game route).
context_for_next_testing_agent: For local-game chat testing, /game/local_short_<anything> works fully offline; seat 0 chat is committed locally and the chat bubble auto-hides after ~4s. Capture both bounding_box()s within ~1s of clicking the chat chip.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was that on right-anchored seats (seat 0 bottom and seat 2 top), both chatBubble and bid/contract bubble used bubbleSide='right' with left:82 and identical `top` offsets and same zIndex 12, so the later-rendered bid/contract bubble covered the chat bubble. Fix stacks the chat bubble 28px higher and bumps its zIndex to 13 when a bid/contract is present. Verified: gap of ~9px between the two bubbles, chat visibly above contract, no regression on either bubble alone.
